binds: All accepted results bind to this one candidate.
requalify_rule: After any change to the candidate commit, the image, or the harness, requalify. Any change under src/tessera/, csrc/, the five roster test files or the test modules they import is a change to measured code: rerun both suites. For any other change, write a dependency analysis that names each retained node and why the change cannot reach it.
historical_harness_note: accepted_harness_head is the historical run2 identity. Current requalification uses the exact harness digests and immutable snapshot receipt in results/requalification.json.
